certificate.stopping_bias_proof: Stopped Dynkin's identity gives the interior backward polynomial plus a boundary correction. In normalized units |Y|<=sqrt(2N), the formal heat mean has the same bound and its conditional covariance entries have magnitude<=2. Hence mean correction<=2sqrt(2N)P; raw-second correction<=(4N+2)P; the mean-product correction<=8NP, giving covariance bound(12N+2)P. No globally defined unstopped DK process is assumed.
